design_direction.rationale: People hire a plumber on trust and proof, not atmosphere, so the page should open with the 2,272 Google reviews and 4.9 rating before anything else, then move straight into services and photos of real work being done. Red pulls from their own truck wrap and uniforms, giving them a distinct, trade-appropriate identity rather than a generic blue.
design_direction.signature_why: A licence-mark stamp repeated near the guarantee text reinforces that these are licensed, vetted professionals, which is exactly what a homeowner checks before calling a plumber.

blocks.heading: Local Plumbing Experts in Frisco, TX
blocks.text: Every day, homeowners in Frisco depend on their plumbing for so many essential activities. When your plumbing has a problem, things like cooking, cleaning, laundry, and more could all be at risk. That’s why residents of Sports City, USA, demand a reputable, skilled plumbing services provider to make sure their plumbing working when it’s needed most. Legacy Plumbing is Frisco’s leading provider of dependable, expert plumbing services. We offer trusted solution-oriented plumbing services, and our plumbers have comprehensive training and extensive experience handling plumbing challenges of all kinds. To get more information about our plumbing services in Frisco, contact the Legacy Plumbing professionals today.

blocks.heading: Sewer & Drain Services
blocks.text: Your home’s sewers and drains are the unsung heroes of your plumbing system. When they perform at their best, there should be very little to notice. However, when there’s a problem, the results can be stressful, disruptive, and damaging. That’s why our team offers professional sewer and drain services you can count on, including: Sewer and drain cleaning Sewer line repair and replacement Drain and sewer line camera inspection

blocks.heading: Kitchen & Bath Plumbing in Frisco
blocks.text: Whether you’re dealing with a leaky faucet or need to install a new garbage disposal, the plumbing experts at Legacy Plumbing handle it all. Count on our superior workmanship for kitchen and bath plumbing installations and repairs for: Faucets Fixtures Toilets Garbage disposals And more Schedule Plumbing Services Today

blocks.heading: Leak Detection & Repair in Frisco
blocks.text: When there’s a leak in your home, and you can’t find it, water can be a costly problem. That’s why at Legacy Plumbing we take our leak detection and repair services seriously. Especially if your home has a slab foundation, leaks can cause significant damage to your property that’s quite expensive to correct. Our services are specifically designed to minimize any disruption to your home and correct problems quickly and efficiently.

blocks.heading: Water Heater Installation & Repair
blocks.text: You depend on your water heater to do its job every day, 24 hours a day. When it’s time for water heater services, the plumbers at Legacy Plumbing have the knowledge and experience to get the job done right the first time. Trust us for outstanding water heater services , including installation and repair for both tank and tankless models .

blocks.heading: Gas Line Plumbing & Gas Leak Repair
blocks.text: Potential gas line problems are nothing to ignore. If you suspect a gas leak, leave the property immediately and contact a professional gas line services provider. If not properly handled, there are serious health risks and fire hazards. Legacy Plumbing offers reliable, safe, and effective gas line plumbing and leak repair services designed to quickly resolve gas-related problems.

testimonials.author: Brian Smith
testimonials.text: Thank you to the Legacy Plumbing Team!!  Everyone I communicated with did a great job.  Canon helped me with the initial details and then Daniel and team did a fantastic job completing the project.  It was a great experience and I highly recommend their services.  Our new 75 gallon water heater is great!!

testimonials.author: Randall Jones
testimonials.text:
Honest hardworking contractors are nearly impossible to find these days.  Brandon at Legacy went above and beyond to prove there’s still some good guys left.  No upselling, no bs, just a thorough and expedited diagnosis and repair at a very reasonable rate.

Legacy has all my business going forward.

Greatly appreciated!

testimonials.author: Eric Way
testimonials.text:
These guys are SO GOOD AT WHAT THEY DO!

Big shout out to our plumber, Sheldon! He has taken care of the pipes in 2 of our homes and has delivered quality work every time. ☺️

Thank you guys for making this process smooth and easy for us. We booked our appointment online, received a confirmation call, and the administrative team was able to move up our appointment to accommodate our timeline.

My family and I truly appreciate you guys! I highly recommend that if you have a plumbing issue, give them an opportunity to fix it for you.

testimonials.author: Jennifer Haefner
testimonials.text: Brandon and his coworker did an excellent job on our plumbing repair. They were professional, courteous, and took the time to explain everything clearly. They worked efficiently, left the area clean, and made sure everything was working perfectly before they left. I really appreciated their friendly attitude and attention to detail. I would definitely recommend this company and would be happy to use them again. Thank you, Brandon and your teammate, for a job well done!

testimonials.author: Kerri Parker
testimonials.text: Great service and great techian. Nancy and Nick made my service experience extremely easy. Nick explained the services I would need and Nancy patiently took care of the financing. This is my third service with Legacy. Always helpful and professional.
